hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Wall thickness checks on chokes, tees, and elbows carrying proppant returns.

name: Plug valves
function: The quarter-turn plug valves that isolate each run and the bypass so a choke can be changed or a run bled with the well flowing through the other.

tabs.overview: A tapered or cylindrical plug turns a quarter turn in a lubricated body; the position bar on the stem shows open or closed. Greased on a schedule so they turn under pressure.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the manifold; 3 in. class.
tabs.safety: Never opened with pressure trapped on the other side without equalizing; the position bar is the field check.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
